title: NegOr geothermal plant upgrade to add 13.5MW to Visayas grid

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — A major modernization project is expected to boost the installed capacity of the Palinpinon-1 geothermal power plant in Valencia, Negros Oriental, from 112.5 to 126 megawatts (MW), adding 13.5MW to the Visayas grid. In a statement, First Gen Corp. (First Gen) said the rehabilitation initiative, undertaken by its geothermal arm, Energy Development Corp. (EDC), will replace the facility’s three legacy 37.5-MW turbine generators, which have provided clean energy for more than 40 years, with three highly efficient, state-of-the-art 42-MW units.
